lines.text: And there it is! {winner} takes season {season}, with barely daylight between the managers.
What a finish! {winnerClub} edges {loserClub}, and this season belongs to {winner}.
That is tight. {winner} has just held off {loser} by {margin}, right at the finish.
Look at that gap! {winner} is through by {margin}, after a season that refused to separate them.
It's {winner} on top! {loser} pushed all the way, but the final margin is razor thin.
Season {season} goes to {winner}! {loser} was close enough to make every point matter.
There is your verdict. {winnerClub} has the edge, but {loserClub} made it desperately close.
Unbelievably tight at the top, but {winner} gets the nod over {loser}.
Balanced on a knife edge, this season finally tilts toward {winner}!
Just enough from {winner}, just not quite enough from {loser}. That's the season!
The table can finally breathe! {winner} finishes narrowly clear of {loser}.
That's the finest of margins. {winnerClub} prevails over {loserClub} at the finish.
Nothing comfortable about that. {winner} has squeezed past {loser} to claim the season.
Here comes the verdict, and it's {winner}! The difference could scarcely be smaller.
You couldn't have asked for much closer. {winner} has scraped home against {loser}.
Every point counted, and {winner} has found just enough to finish ahead of {loser}.
Now the gap is official. {margin} between them, and {winner} takes the season.
Almost a dead heat, but not quite. {winner} has made the difference.
The season hangs on the finest thread, and {winner} comes out in front.
No room to relax for {winner}, but the final table puts them ahead of {loser}.
There were no acres of space here. {winner} edges it, and {loser} was right there.
At the end of season {season}, it's {winner} by the narrowest of margins.
This is seriously close, but not level! {winner} wins the season!
Barely breathing room, but a full season to celebrate. {winner} takes the honors.
They can finally call it. {winner} has beaten {loser}, and only just.
That final tally says it all, {winnerPoints} to {loserPoints}, and {winner} survives the squeeze.
Tense to the last point! {winner} takes the spoils, {loser} takes the near miss.
Out of all that season's work, {margin} separates them! {winner} holds on.
Right at the line, {winner} nicks it from {loser}! What a season result.
Put {winner} at the top, but keep {loser} close beneath. That was a scrap.
Once the dust settles on season {season}, {winner} is only just ahead.
You can see it in the standings. {winner} finishes ahead of {loser} by {margin}.
Absolutely nothing to spare. {winnerClub} has edged out {loserClub} for the season.
Listen to that verdict. {winner} ahead of {loser}, with hardly a gap to speak of.
Nowhere to hide in those figures. {winnerPoints} against {loserPoints}, and {winner} takes it.
After all that, it's {winner} by {margin}! {loser} made them fight for every inch.
A tight race, a clear result, and {winner} just about crosses ahead of {loser}!
Such a slender lead. {winner} has done enough, with {loser} snapping at the heels.
Final figures, final verdict. {winner} wins this season by the tiniest gap.
Across the finish line comes {winner}, with {loser} close enough to feel the breeze!
Someone find a magnifying glass! That's how narrow {winner}'s advantage over {loser} is.
Well, {winner} can smile now. {loser} nearly had that smile for themselves.
Good luck calling that early! {winner} gets there, and {loser} almost steals the headline.
If {winner} wanted an easy finish, {loser} clearly didn't get the message!
Barely room for a headline between them. {winner} pinches the season from {loser}.
You might need a ruler for that gap! {winner} beats {loser} by {margin}.
That trophy cabinet can wait. For now, {winner} has the season, but only narrowly.
Don't blink at those standings. {winnerClub} has edged {loserClub}, and that's the difference.
Quite a way to earn your bragging rights! {winner} edges {loser} by {margin}.
So close, {loser} could almost reach across the table. Yet {winner} takes it.
Nothing like making it difficult! {winner} wins the season with {loser} breathing down their neck.
Narrow escape, if ever there was one! {winner} just beats {loser}.
Try putting daylight between those totals. {winner} couldn't, but the lead still counts.
Is there a smaller cushion? {winner} won't care, because they've claimed season {season}.
Call it tight, call it tense, call it {winner}'s season! {loser} came so close.
Even the table looks surprised! {winner} edges ahead of {loser} right at the end.
Comfort is for armchairs, not this season. {winner} barely squeezes past {loser}.
Tell {loser} the margin was {margin}, and expect a long look at the standings!
Very little in it, and a lot to talk about. {winner} has beaten {loser}.
Better keep that victory speech short. {winner} won, but {loser} was right alongside.
Who needs a landslide? {winner} takes the season with the smallest bit of daylight.
Not quite enough for {loser}, and just enough for {winner}. Football can be cruelly precise.
No victory lap here, just a careful step! {winner} noses past {loser}.
Imagine trying to split those totals! {winnerPoints} against {loserPoints}, and {winner} edges it.
Bragging rights belong to {winner}, but {loser} can point to a very small gap.
Now there's a result to argue over! {winner} wins it, {loser} almost says otherwise.
Almost impossible to separate them, and still {winner} finds a way past {loser}!
Spare a thought for {loser}. They were within touching distance, but {winner} held on.
Small margin, enormous smile! {winner} has just squeaked past {loser} for the season.
There's your close shave! {winnerClub} takes it over {loserClub}, with no room for comfort.
Nobody promised {winner} an easy season. {loser} has made absolutely sure of that.
Just look how little separates them! {winner} by {margin}, and every bit was earned.
Surely {loser} will want another look at that table! {winner} is narrowly ahead.
Fine print decides this season. {winner} gets top billing, while {loser} gets the near miss.
Some wins come with a cushion. {winner}'s comes with {loser} right on the shoulder!
Hold the final page! {winner} has taken season {season} from {loser} by a whisper!
On a razor's edge, with everything in the balance, {winner} has emerged ahead!
And it all comes down to this! {winner} over {loser}, the finest of separations!
Silence before the verdict, then the roar! {winner} takes a breathtakingly narrow season!
This season's race could scarcely be tighter! {winner} scrapes past {loser}, and it's theirs!
Every ounce of a season rests on that sliver! {winner} edges out {loser}.
At the very last reckoning, {winner} stands above {loser}, but only by {margin}!
What a thread to hang a season on! {winnerClub} narrowly over {loserClub}!
Feel that tension break! {winner} is ahead, {loser} denied by the narrowest margin.
Through all the twists of the table, {winner} has clung to the smallest lead!
The final numbers are in! {winnerPoints} to {loserPoints}, and {winner} claims the season!
Under the weight of a whole season, that slender advantage held! {winner} takes it.
Imagine being this close to a draw! {winner} still finds the edge over {loser}.
There's no wider gap to celebrate, just victory itself! {winner} has beaten {loser}!
Nerves stretched to breaking point! {winner} takes the season, {loser} inches away.
The line between triumph and frustration is almost invisible! {winner} is on the right side!
Right down to the final accounting! {winner} edges {loser} by {margin}, and the season is sealed!
No runaway, no procession, just {winner} holding the advantage over {loser} at the finish!
What a squeeze at the top this season! {winner} escapes with the win!
It's almost level, but not quite! {winner} takes a season decided by the finest margin!
Barely a breath separates their seasons! {winner} emerges ahead, and {loser} must regroup.
To think it came down to {margin}! {winner} ahead of {loser}, and every point mattered!
Here is a slender triumph with an enormous feeling! {winner} edges it.
This is the kind of finish that stays with you! {winner} just ahead of {loser}!
And when the dust finally settles, {winner} wins it by a hair! What a finish!

_note: cb3-097 "every fraction" changed to "every point" (points are whole numbers).
